title: Battle of Waynesboro, Virginia
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Waynesboro, Virginia", at revision 1370593490, opens: "The Battle of Waynesboro was fought on March 2, 1865, at Waynesboro in Augusta County, Virginia, during the American Civil War. It was a complete victory for Brig. Gen. George Armstrong Custer and the final battle for Confederate Lt. Gen. Jubal Early, whose force was destroyed." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2890377, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle of the American Civil War in Virginia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
